checks.finding: Pinned source says static @Container is shared among methods of one class and stops after last; instance field starts/stops each method. It explicitly says parallel execution unsupported. This confirms class scope does not mean all JVM classes.
Experimental; requires opt-in, withReuse(true), manual start, and avoiding stop/JUnit lifecycle; docs say unsuitable for CI. Separate from static class-scoped containers.

determineHistory: useHistory true selects temp-dir path only where explicit input/output locations are null; false sets explicitly configured input/output paths. Thus mixed withHistory and explicit paths do not guarantee use of temp file; prior wording that it selects a different branch is correct, refined to preserve null-specific behavior.
Adapter 1.2.1 requires PIT 1.15.2 or above; PIT 1.15.3 satisfies that minimum. README notes tested JUnit Platform range through 1.10.0-M1 and potential issues beyond.

Jobs without rules default to except: merge_requests. Explicit schedule and merge_request_event rules add jobs to those pipeline types. Supplied example gives both jobs schedule/MR rules; mutation job adds changes to MR rule. Actual project pipeline still depends on workflow and full config.
Fowler says TDD was developed by Kent Beck in late 1990s as part of XP; describes test, functional code until pass, refactor, commonly summarized Red-Green-Refactor.
